status: Fixed in quickfix pending governed commit
finding: taskflow close accepted --defer-governance-dirty and --defer-foreign-state at the close transaction boundary, but did not pass that explicit operator choice into historical close preflight. Consequently the preflight classified the reproducible global .atm/history/evidence/git-head.jsonl audit as blocking governance dirty state before the close transaction could snapshot and restore it.
expectedBehavior: Without an explicit deferral flag, governance dirty files remain fail-closed. With --defer-governance-dirty or its --defer-foreign-state alias, only the existing proven deferrable shapes (git-head evidence and the current task bundle manifest) are reclassified advisory for the close transaction; foreign task history and unknown governance files remain blocking.
evidenceOrRepro: The focused current-task-close-evidence fixture first proves dirty git-head evidence blocks default preflight, then proves the same fixture is advisory only when deferGovernanceDirty is true. Source-first taskflow close for ATM-GOV-0369 with --defer-foreign-state no longer emits ATM_TASK_CLOSE_DIRTY_WORKTREE; its remaining blocker is the unrelated physical-line-budget report from pre-existing broad task scope.
followUp: Publish this quickfix in the next controlled runner build, then retry the 0369 close dry-run using explicit deferral. Do not use the flag to suppress foreign task evidence or unclassified governance state.
